visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a shot of a brightly lit food menu board at a Costco warehouse. The central focus is a menu item for 'Brown Sugar Egg Tart 2ct' priced at 69元, alongside other items like Thai Pork Larb Sandwich and Sushi Combo. In the background, people wearing face masks and dark clothing are seen walking through the food court area. (2) A woman with short dark hair and a light green t-shirt appears, holding two egg tarts in their silver foil cups toward the camera lens. She is in a semi-outdoor covered area with a concrete floor and a white pillar nearby. The lighting is natural daylight. Her facial expression is animated as she talks. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the egg tarts placed in a white circular tray. The camera captures the flaky, multi-layered texture of the pastry crust and the glistening, dark brown sugar filling in the center. The woman points her finger at the layers of one tart, showcasing the crispiness. (4) The camera shifts to a medium close-up as the woman takes a bite of the egg tart. She chews while looking at the camera, her expression suggesting evaluation. She then shows the cross-section of the tart, revealing a thick crust and a generous amount of filling. (5) A man with short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt with a small graphic, is seen taking a large bite of the egg tart. He looks directly at the camera while chewing, providing his reaction. The background is a simple outdoor structure with white siding. (6) The woman reappears, holding the tray and finishing her review. She raises a peace sign to her eye level, but a pixelated graphic with the text '保護當事人' (Protect the party involved) is overlaid on the upper part of her face as she smiles.
